fields.description: Record encoding flag in the EEPROM temp-buffer header: 0 = plain payload at offset 3, 1 = compressed payload at offset 5 with u16 length at offset 3.
fields.evidence: FUN_080036b0 branches on *pcVar4==0 (plain, decomp lines ~2017/2063) vs else (compressed path reading *(ushort*)(pcVar4+3), line ~2034); temp-buffer byte 0 maps to save-file logical offset 0.
fields.name: save_format_flag

fields.description: Stored 16-bit header checksum written by FUN_080036b0 from FUN_080034a4(payload, len, len) = (sum(payload bytes) + 2*len + 1) & 0xFFFF. Baseline: sum=604, len=11 -> 627 = 0x0273, matches. Custom algorithm (not in Schema v2 list), so stored as a plain field and documented in SPEC.md.
fields.evidence: FUN_080034a4 (decomp line ~1779) sums bytes then returns (sum + param_2 + param_3 + 1) & 0xFFFF; FUN_080036b0 stores/compares it at *(short*)(pcVar4+1) (lines ~1950/2019/2035/2072); verified 0x0273 against baseline logical bytes.
fields.name: payload_checksum

fields.description: 10-character ASCII save identifier stamped by the game, NUL-terminated at offset 13. Baseline reads 'INU040407A'. Gathered into the temp buffer from the per-block ROM table via DAT_08003750 in the FUN_080036b0 write path.
fields.evidence: FUN_080036b0 write path gathers payload bytes via table *(param_1*4 + DAT_08003750) with FUN_08034624 (lines ~1935-1944); baseline logical bytes [3,13) decode to ASCII 'INU040407A' inside the checksum-covered span [3,14).
fields.name: save_identifier

fields.description: NUL terminator of the save identifier: end byte of the 11-byte checksum-covered payload [3,14) sized by FUN_08003688/FUN_08003470 for block 0. Baseline 0x00.
fields.evidence: FUN_080036b0 sizes the block-0 payload (iVar5 via FUN_08003688/FUN_08003470, lines ~1881/1757) and checksums span [3,14); byte 13 is the 11th payload byte, 0x00 in baseline.
fields.name: identifier_terminator

fields.description: Zero alignment padding rounding the 14-byte record (flag + checksum + 11-byte payload) up to the 16-byte / 2-block EEPROM granularity. FUN_080036b0 pads uVar9 up to a multiple of 8 before writing 8-byte blocks via FUN_080340d8.
fields.evidence: FUN_080036b0 block-rounding at lines ~1976-1984 ((uVar9+8)-remainder) and 8-byte stepped writes via FUN_080340d8/FUN_08033e5c/FUN_08033f20 (lines ~1989/2010); baseline logical [14,16) is 0x0000.
fields.name: record_pad

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'INU040407A' save identifier at logical offset 3 (raw bytes 34 30 55 4e at raw offset 0 are the same data before 8-byte block reversal)
